svg.text: RJTech — Complete Application UML Class Diagram (All 4 Layers in One Image)
ViewModels · Controllers · Services · Models (EF entities) · DatabaseContext — every class present and connected
Band colors — green: ViewModels · blue: Controllers · purple: Services · teal: Models · slate: Data.
+ Text / Integer / Currency / Date / Percentage / Status

Lane-routing keeps connectors in inter-column gutters; dashed rows into ApplicationDbContext are representative DbSet persistence links (one per entity). Shared services (InstallmentService, StockNotificationService, UserAuthenticationService, PasswordHashService) are reused by multiple modules.
